visual_review.method: PDF pages 1, 4, 6, 7, 10 and 11 rendered and read (cover, diplomas, their signature page, the termo and its signed facsimile); the declaration (page 9) read from the text layer. CLAUDE-C01-17 (br_vice_president rows): PDF pages 4-7 (the diplomas and the TSE ministers' signature pages; page 6 is the Vice-President's), 9 (his oath, signed termo de compromisso and the declaration), 10 (typed termo) and 11 (signed termo and salutation) rendered and read; pages 3 and 12 read from the text layer.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Rousseff and Temer were elected on 26 October 2014; the reproduced TSE diploma says Dilma Vana Rousseff, candidate of the Com a Força do Povo coalition, was elected President of the Republic by the will expressed at the polls on 26 October 2014.

locator.section: Opening declaration by Renan Calheiros; diploma on p. 4

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The reproduced TSE diploma, dated Brasília 18 December 2014 and signed by Minister José Antonio Dias Toffoli as President of the Court, qualifies her for investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 2015; the opening and termo date the diplomação to 18 December 2014.

locator.section: Facsimile of the TSE diploma (printed sideways): "Brasília, dezoito de dezembro de dois mil e quatorze"

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2015 (15:19-16:32), Renan Calheiros invited the President of the Republic to take the constitutional commitment, and Dilma Rousseff recited it.

locator.section: "A SRª DILMA ROUSSEFF - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Renan Calheiros, "with the powers granted by the Federal Constitution", declared Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer empossados as President and Vice-President of the Republic for the period 1 January 2015 to 31 December 2018; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados for the period beginning on that date.

locator.section: "declaro empossados nos cargos de Presidenta e Vice-Presidente da República ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2015 a 31 de dezembro de 2018"; opening on p. 3

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2015, before the National Congress in joint session in the Chamber plenary, Dilma Rousseff was solemnly empossada as President of the Republic under article 78 of the Constitution, elected on 26 October 2014 and diplomada by the TSE on 18 December 2014, for the period 1 January 2015 to 31 December 2018.

locator.section: Termo read; signed facsimile on p. 11

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer were elected on 26 October 2014; the reproduced TSE diploma says Michel Miguel Elias Temer Lulia, candidate of the Com a Força do Povo coalition (PT, PMDB, PRB, PP, PDT, PR, PSD, PCdoB, PROS), was elected Vice-President of the Republic by the will expressed at the polls on 26 October 2014.

locator.section: Opening by Renan Calheiros ("eleitos em 26 de outubro de 2014"); diploma on p. 6

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The reproduced TSE diploma, dated Brasília 18 December 2014 and signed by Minister José Antonio Dias Toffoli as President of the Court, followed by a page of the Court's ministers' signatures, qualifies Michel Miguel Elias Temer Lulia for investiture in the office of Vice-President before the National Congress on 1 January 2015; the opening and his termo de compromisso date the diplomação to 18 December 2014.

locator.section: Facsimile of the Vice-President's TSE diploma, printed sideways ("Brasília, dezoito de dezembro de dois mil e quatorze"); signature page p. 7

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2015 (15:19-16:32), after Rousseff, Renan Calheiros invited "o Exmo. Vice-Presidente da República eleito, Sr. Michel Temer" to take the constitutional commitment, and he recited it; the record reproduces his signed termo de compromisso under article 78, "prestado em 1º de janeiro de 2015", naming him as elected to the office of Vice-President on 26 October 2014 and diplomado on 18 December 2014.

locator.section: "O SR. MICHEL TEMER - Prometo manter..."; boxed facsimile "TERMO DE COMPROMISSO ... PRESTADO EM 1º DE JANEIRO DE 2015"

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Renan Calheiros, "with the powers granted by the Federal Constitution", declared Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer empossados in the offices of President and Vice-President of the Republic respectively, for the period 1 January 2015 to 31 December 2018; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados "para o período a iniciar-se nesta data".

locator.section: "declaro empossados nos cargos de Presidenta e Vice-Presidente da República a Exma. Sra. Dilma Rousseff e o Exmo. Sr. Michel Temer, respectivamente, para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2015 a 31 de dezembro de 2018"; opening on p. 3

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The joint termo de posse records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2015, before the National Congress in joint session, Dilma Rousseff and Michel Temer were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution in the offices of President and Vice-President respectively, elected on 26 October 2014 and diplomados on 18 December 2014, for the period 1 January 2015 to 31 December 2018; the signed facsimile says "reeleitos".

locator.section: Typed termo; signed facsimile on p. 11

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the posse, Rousseff's address salutes "Sr. Vice-Presidente da República, Michel Temer" and later speaks of "meu querido Vice-Presidente Michel Temer, parceiro de todas as horas".

locator.section: Salutation of Rousseff's address; the second passage on p. 12 (text layer)
